method: 60 Hz full sensor updates; real car, collisions, checkpoints, and track geometry; shared initial seeds; no vector archive

decisions.method: Paired bootstrap of adaptive minus fixed final best progress, resampling whole (track, seed) clusters (10000 resamples; expanded percentile 95% interval). pass: lower bound at or above minimumEffect; fail: upper bound below minimumEffect (a gain of that size is ruled out; exact ties give [0, 0]); otherwise inconclusive. Fewer than 6 clusters is always inconclusive. A track whose interval lies below 0 vetoes a pooled pass.
